title: Gyges
summary: King of Lydia, first of the Mermnadae; in Herodotus he kills Candaules and takes the throne (1.8–14).
description: Added from the Herodotus import (The Histories, tr. Rawlinson). Herodotus gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not BC years, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Herodotus is display-only and gives none).

reign.date: “Archilochus the Parian, who lived about the same time”
reign.citation: Herodotus, Histories 1.12 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 6 (PDF p. 8)
reign.note: Synchronism: the poet Archilochus was a contemporary of Gyges' seizure of the throne.

reign.date: “in the fifth generation from Gyges, vengeance should come for the Heraclides”
reign.citation: Herodotus, Histories 1.13 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 6 (PDF p. 8)
reign.note: Delphic oracle at Gyges' accession; fulfilled in Croesus (1.91 calls Gyges Croesus's "fifth ancestor").

reign.date: “though he reigned eight and thirty years”
reign.citation: Herodotus, Histories 1.14 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 6 (PDF p. 8)
